mapper.select: SELECT museum_id AS museumId, object_id AS objectId, title, artist, artist_province AS artistProvince, dynasty, artist_wikidata_id AS artistWikidataId, artist_birth AS artistBirth, artist_death AS artistDeath, artist_bio AS artistBio, artist_wikipedia_summary AS artistWikipediaSummary, artist_enriched_at AS artistEnrichedAt, period, period_start_year AS periodStartYear, period_end_year AS periodEndYear, type, material, culture, description, provenance, bibliography, dimensions, museum, location, detail_url AS detailUrl, image_url AS imageUrl, iiif_manifest_url AS iiifManifestUrl, image_path AS imagePath, credit_line AS creditLine, accession_number AS accessionNumber, crawl_date AS crawlDate FROM artifact WHERE museum_id = #{museumId} AND object_id = #{objectId}
